_doc: Skills. Each levels on its own (xp from kills while slotted) and gets 1 specialisation point per level. Nodes: req = points already spent in this skill's tree, parent = needs >= 1 point there first, vals are per point. Attacks scale from the staff's damage, spells from their own base damage (+per_level_pct per skill level).

sunlash.name: Sunlash
sunlash.desc: Crack a whip of light from the lantern. Every third lash is a heavy crack.

nodes.name: Quick Wrist
nodes.text: +8% Sunlash attack speed per point

nodes.name: Long Cord
nodes.text: +12% lash reach per point

nodes.name: Sear
nodes.text: +15% chance per point to ignite (60% of the hit as burning over 2 s)

nodes.name: Kindling
nodes.text: Each enemy hit feeds the lantern +0.5 Light per point

nodes.name: Backhand
nodes.text: Lashes also strike behind you

nodes.name: Cruel in the Dark
nodes.text: +20% damage per point to Shrouded enemies

nodes.name: Sunwave
nodes.text: The third crack sends a crescent of light forward (70% damage, pierces)

nodes.name: Twin Crescents
nodes.text: Sunwave: +1 crescent per point, fanned out

flare.name: Flare
flare.desc: Open the lantern's shutters: a burst of sunfire around you. Its size follows your Light.

nodes.name: Wide Shutters
nodes.text: +12% area per point

nodes.name: Refuel
nodes.text: +2 Oil per enemy hit per point

nodes.name: Blinding
nodes.text: Stuns enemies hit for 0.25 s per point

nodes.name: Spend the Flame
nodes.text: Burns 15 Light for +80% damage (only above 30 Light)

nodes.name: Afterglow
nodes.text: Leaves a burning ring for 1.5 s per point (25% damage per second)

nodes.name: Noonday
nodes.text: +30% damage per point while Blazing

nodes.name: Lancet
nodes.text: Flare becomes a long cone toward the cursor: double reach, +40% damage

lantern_toss.name: Lantern Toss
lantern_toss.desc: Throw the lantern. It burns where it lands and lights that ground, while you fight in the dark. Cast again to call it back.

nodes.name: Heavy Iron
nodes.text: +25% impact damage and a harder knockback per point

nodes.name: Long Burn
nodes.text: +1.5 s on the ground per point

nodes.name: Beacon
nodes.text: Enemies in the thrown lantern's light take +10% damage per point

nodes.name: Dark Adept
nodes.text: While the lantern is away: +30% damage and +15% movement speed

nodes.name: Homecoming
nodes.text: The return flight deals +50% damage per point

nodes.name: Tether
nodes.text: The return flight drags enemies it hits toward you

nodes.name: Ember Trail
nodes.text: Both flights leave burning embers on the ground for 2 s

moth_swarm.name: Moth Swarm
moth_swarm.desc: Loose ember moths from the lantern. They flutter toward the cursor, then seek the nearest enemy.

nodes.name: Brood
nodes.text: +1 moth per point

nodes.name: Swift Wings
nodes.text: +15% moth speed and +8% damage per point

nodes.name: Light-Feeders
nodes.text: Each moth hit feeds the lantern +0.6 Light per point

nodes.name: Cinder Moths
nodes.text: Moths burst on impact: 40% damage per point in a small area

nodes.name: Linger
nodes.text: Moths survive their first hit and seek another enemy

nodes.name: Guardians
nodes.text: 2 moths circle you for 6 s and burn enemy projectiles they touch

nodes.name: Matriarch
nodes.text: Every 4th cast also looses a great moth: triple damage, pierces

dash.name: Wickstep
dash.desc: Step through the dark faster than it can close: a short dash, untouchable while it lasts.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.desc: Shutter the lantern. For a few breaths every enemy is Shrouded, and you strike like the dark itself. When the shutter opens, the light bursts out.

nodes.name: Long Night
nodes.text: +1 s of Eclipse per point

nodes.name: Night Hunger
nodes.text: +1% of damage dealt returned as life per point

nodes.name: Predator
nodes.text: +10% movement speed during Eclipse per point

nodes.name: Unshutter
nodes.text: The closing burst deals +60% damage and reaches 20% further per point

nodes.name: Umbra
nodes.text: Enemies that die during Eclipse burst into shadow, hurting those around them (50% damage)

nodes.name: Pitch Dark
nodes.text: During Eclipse, Flare and Lantern Toss cost no Oil

nodes.name: New Moon
nodes.text: Eclipse's cooldown recovers 30% faster, and kills during it add 1 s (up to 4 s)

noon.name: Noon
noon.desc: For one breath, daylight. Every enemy you can see burns and reels, and your lantern blazes at full for a while.

nodes.name: High Noon
nodes.text: +40% damage per point

nodes.name: Long Day
nodes.text: Your lantern stays at full Light 3 s longer per point

nodes.name: Sunburn
nodes.text: Enemies hit burn for 50% of the hit per point over 2 s

nodes.name: Zenith
nodes.text: Noon recovers 25% faster

nodes.name: Noon Bell
nodes.text: Noon also restores 30% of your life

nodes.name: Second Sun
nodes.text: Noon leaves a small sun where you stood for 6 s: it lights the ground and burns what stands in it

kindle.name: Kindle
kindle.desc: Feed the lantern's fire into your hands. For a while every hit carries added sunfire and may set the target alight.

nodes.name: Long Kindle
nodes.text: +2 s per point

nodes.name: Stoke
nodes.text: +25% added sunfire per point

nodes.name: Warm Hands
nodes.text: +10% attack and cast speed per point while kindled

nodes.name: Ember Skin
nodes.text: While kindled, whatever hits you is set alight

nodes.name: Wildfire
nodes.text: While kindled, burning enemies that die set their neighbours alight

hook.name: Hook
hook.desc: Cast the light-whip out in a line. The first thing it catches is dragged to your feet and left reeling.

nodes.name: Barbed
nodes.text: +25% damage per point

nodes.name: Long Line
nodes.text: +20% reach per point

nodes.name: Drag the Light
nodes.text: Each catch feeds the lantern +3 Light per point

nodes.name: Double Hook
nodes.text: Catches the first two enemies in the line

nodes.name: Snap
nodes.text: Caught enemies are struck again by a free Sunlash crack

glass_ward.name: Glass Ward
glass_ward.desc: Glass grows over your coat: a barrier that takes hits for you. When it breaks or fades, it bursts outward in shards.

nodes.name: Thick Glass
nodes.text: +10% of your life as barrier per point

nodes.name: Sharp Edges
nodes.text: +40% burst damage per point

nodes.name: Quick Set
nodes.text: -1.5 s cooldown per point

nodes.name: Mirror
nodes.text: While the ward holds, enemy shots that touch you shatter

nodes.name: Rewall
nodes.text: The burst grows a smaller second ward (half as strong)

cinder_rain.name: Cinder Rain
cinder_rain.desc: Cinders fall from the dark onto a place you choose, each one a small burst of sunfire.

nodes.name: Downpour
nodes.text: +2 cinders per point

nodes.name: Wide Rain
nodes.text: +20% area per point

nodes.name: Guided
nodes.text: Cinders fall on enemies in the area first

nodes.name: Lingering
nodes.text: Each cinder leaves fire on the ground for 1.5 s per point

nodes.name: Last Cinder
nodes.text: The rain ends with one great cinder (400% damage, wide)

wick_trap.name: Wick Trap
wick_trap.desc: Set a lit wick in the ground. When something steps near, it bursts. Up to three at once.

nodes.name: More Wicks
nodes.text: +1 trap at once per point

nodes.name: Big Bang
nodes.text: +15% area and +20% damage per point

nodes.name: Bright Wick
nodes.text: Each burst feeds the lantern +2 Light per point

nodes.name: Chain
nodes.text: A burst sets off any trap within its reach

nodes.name: Snare
nodes.text: Bursts stun for 0.8 s

lull.name: Lull
lull.desc: Strike the lantern like a bell. The tone stuns everything near you for a moment. (The order knows this sound. So does the sun.)

nodes.name: Deep Toll
nodes.text: +0.3 s stun per point

nodes.name: Wide Toll
nodes.text: +15% radius per point

nodes.name: Resonance
nodes.text: +2 Oil per enemy struck per point

nodes.name: Echo
nodes.text: The bell rings again a second later at half strength

nodes.name: Hush
nodes.text: Stunned enemies take 25% more damage while stunned
